name: Agri-Clinics & Agri-Business Centres (AC&ABC)
eligibility_facts: some biological science graduates with qualifying agriculture PG
hard_exclusions: retired employees receiving pension are not eligible for subsidy
questions: What is your highest agriculture/allied educational qualification?
What agriculture-related business do you want to start?

source_text_aliases: some biological science graduates with qualifying agriculture PG

question.en: Do you hold one of the agriculture, allied-subject, biological-science-with-qualifying-PG, diploma, or agriculture-related intermediate qualifications specified by the scheme?
question.or: ଏହି ଯୋଜନାରେ ଉଲ୍ଲେଖିତ କୃଷି, ସହଯୋଗୀ ବିଷୟ, ଯୋଗ୍ୟ PG ସହ ଜୀବବିଜ୍ଞାନ, ଡିପ୍ଲୋମା କିମ୍ବା କୃଷିସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ଯୁକ୍ତଦୁଇ ଯୋଗ୍ୟତା ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କୌଣସିଟି ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଅଛି କି?

help_text.en: The exact course, institution recognition, subject content, and required marks must match the source rules.
help_text.or: ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମ, ସଂସ୍ଥାର ସ୍ୱୀକୃତି, ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ମାର୍କ ଉତ୍ସ ନିୟମ ସହ ମେଳ ହେବା ଦରକାର।

question.en: Are you a retired employee receiving a pension?
question.or: ଆପଣ ପେନସନ୍ ପାଉଥିବା ଜଣେ ଅବସରପ୍ରାପ୍ତ କର୍ମଚାରୀ କି?
